messages:
evan: Quick sync: opened PR #501 to consolidate function/tool-calling docs. Callouts from reviewers: ambiguous nullable guidance, missing TS/JS typed example, and the parse-patterns link is 404. Can we split work?
kevin: I can own the TS/JS snippets. Proposal: show zod + SDK typing and a minimal runtime guard. Want to include a streaming example too?
sasha: Streaming is nice but keep the first pass focused. Key content: explain why `oneOf` wins over `nullable` for compound objects; nullable still ok for simple primitives. Small in-thread example: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"tool_result":{"oneOf":[{"type":"null"},{"type":"object","properties":{"score":{"type":"number"}}}]}}}```
lina: +1 on oneOf. Also suggest a short mapping table in the migration guide: old paths -> new `response.envelope` layout (helps infra and SDK users).
oliver: I'll update the Python snippets and the migration mapping. For Python we should show `pydantic` validation + fallback pattern. Draft: ```py
from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
class Result(BaseModel):
    id: str
    score: float | None
try:
    r = Result.parse_obj(res['response']['envelope']['tool_result'])
except ValidationError:
    # log / fallback to safe path
    r = None
```
kevin: TS draft with zod: ```ts
import { z } from 'zod'
const Result = z.object({ id: z.string(), score: z.number().nullable() })
const parsed = Result.safeParse(res.response.envelope.tool_result)
if (!parsed.success) { throw new Error('invalid response') }
```
ev an: small nit: use `oneOf` equivalent in zod? maybe union with `z.null()` in example.
kevin: updated: ```ts
const Result = z.union([z.null(), z.object({ id: z.string(), score: z.number() })])
```
link-bot: Broken link detected in PR comment: /docs/parse->old -> 404. Suggested replacement: https://docs.redwood.com/inference/structured-responses/parse-patterns. Patch proposed to the PR body.
sasha: also add a short "schema-first" subsection showing AJV + jsonschema validation before mapping to app types. Helps teams avoid silent coercions. Example AJV snippet in JS: ```js
const Ajv = require('ajv')
const ajv = new Ajv()
if (!ajv.validate(schema, res.response.envelope.tool_result)) { console.warn('schema mismatch') }
```
oliver: I'll wire the migration checklist (old->new fields, suggested codemods). Suggest owners: kevin -> TS/JS snippets & PR updates, oliver -> Python snippets & migration section, sasha -> schema wording + review, lina -> migration mapping + codemod examples, evan -> final PR author and merge.
kevin: tagging @link-bot to re-run link check after I push the snippet commit.
link-bot: Link-check queued for PR #501. Will post results here. :white_check_mark:
ev an: Thanks all. Targeting merge by EOD tomorrow assuming the link-check passes and snippets land. Ping this thread if anything blocks.
